## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature

## Validation

- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] `ruff check scripts tools tests` passes
- [ ] `ruff format --check scripts tools tests` passes
- [ ] `python tools/validate_templates.py` passes
- [ ] Documentation was updated when behavior or installation changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` was updated when applicable

Versions tested:

- [ ] Zabbix 7.0
- [ ] Zabbix 8.0
- [ ] Other: 

If a template export changed, describe the Zabbix build used to import/export and verify it.
